name: Four People Without Me
source:
5 friends seeks shelter at a mansion during downpour. Things got weird when one of them getting completely ignored by others except you. Is this some sort of bullying? The answer may be beyond yes or no.

[From [url=https://ojonomo.itch.io/four-people-without-me]Itch.io[/url]]
